newsitem.title: USA: Labor market strain positive for US economy-Rivlin.
newsitem.headline: Labor market strain positive for US economy-Rivlin.

text.p: Strains in the labor market are having a positive effect on the U.S. economy, Federal Reserve Vice Chair Alice Rivlin said Wednesday.
"The tighntess in the labor market is a very beneficial thing for the economy right now," Rivlin said. "We have millions of people who have jobs and job experience that they wouldn't have had."
Rivlin told the House Banking Committee that training less-experienced workers may allow further declines in the jobless rate.
"As people with less job experience who would have been unemployed get training and job experience, we can lower the rate," she said.
